description.narrative: Building upon the analytical foundation of the government's vision on renewable energy development by 2030, the renewable energy scale up program is designed to follow a multiphase programmatic approach (MPA) with three phases. Achieving the vision requires sustained financing to undertake longer-term planning, concerted policy reform and regulatory measures, and infrastructure interventions- both, public financing and risk mitigation to attract private financing. The first phase will focus on development of small hydro and rehabilitation of dilapidated facilities to increase energy generation in the short term. Small HPPs will be prioritized and selected attending to strategic and economic rationale, as well as for its readiness and ability to be deliver energy in the short term to address the increasing winter energy gap. In addition, this phase will strengthen the grid to strengthen the grid to enable RE integration, with potential support from GCF. Funding for this Phase will be committed. The prosed project is aligned with the overarching goal of the Country Partnership Framework (CPF) 2019–22 to promote diversified, export-oriented, inclusive, sustainable growth, focusing on conditions for private sector investment and aligned with the CPF 2022–2027 that is currently being developed.
To increase hydropower generation and enable renewable energy integration by strengthening transmission systems in Kyrgyz Republic

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I. A. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through the MoE, shall be responsible for overall Projectimplementation and maintain throughout Project implementation a PMO to be responsible for performing key project managementfunctions, including coordination, fiduciary, monitoring and evaluation, social and environmental standards management andreporting functions, with mandates, functions, responsibilities, structures, resources and staff, all as further described in thePOM and acceptable to the Association. To this end and without limitation to the generality of the forgoing, the Recipient, throughthe MoE, shall no later than 2 months after the Effective Date, hire a financial management specialist, an occupational and healthsafety specialist, an environmental specialist, a social specialist, and a procurement specialist, all with qualifications,experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I. A. 2. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through the MoE, shall no later than 6 months after theEffective Date, establish, and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, an independent panel of experts on dam safetywith experts with qualifications, experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I. D. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through MoE, shall prepare and adopt the POM in accordancewith this Agreement and in a manner satisfactory to the Association, and shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordancewith the POM, setting forth rules, methods, guidelines, and procedures for the carrying out of the Project, including, inter alia:(a) detailed description of Project and institutional arrangements for implementing the Project (including the roles andresponsibilities and communication channels and modes between the PMO and beneficiary state agencies and entities); (b) selectioncriteria and eligibility criteria and procedures for of the selection of hydro power plants subprojects under Part 1.1 of theProject and grid infrastructure sub-projects under Part 2.1 of the Project, which shall include that the Association shall approvethe final selection of any sub-project; (c) a gender action plan; (d) monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and governance proceduresfor the Project; and (e) overall disbursement, financial management, reporting, planning, budgeting, internal controls, flow offunds, auditing and procurement procedures for the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I. E. 1. of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordancewith the Environmental and Social Standards, in a manner acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section IV. Of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall, no later than 2 months after the Effective Date, installand thereafter maintain, throughout the Project implementation period, accounting software for the Project acceptable to theAssociation.
